question: For each customer and each month of 2020, first calculate the month-end balance by adding all deposit amounts and subtracting all withdrawal amounts that occurred during that specific month. Then determine which month in 2020 has the highest count of customers with a positive month-end balance and which month has the lowest count. For each of these two months, compute the average month-end balance across all customers and provide the difference between these two averages
sql:
-- Compute the difference between avg balance of highest-positive month and lowest-positive month
WITH customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
    FROM customer_transactions
),
months AS (
    SELECT '2020-01' as month
    UNION ALL SELECT '2020-02'
    UNION ALL SELECT '2020-03'
    UNION ALL SELECT '2020-04'
),
balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        substr(txn_date, 1, 7) as month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) - 
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) as month_end_balance
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE substr(txn_date, 1, 4) = '2020'
    GROUP BY customer_id, substr(txn_date, 1, 7)
),
all_combos AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, m.month
    FROM customers c
    CROSS JOIN months m
),
full_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        ac.customer_id,
        ac.month,
        COALESCE(b.month_end_balance, 0) as month_end_balance
    FROM all_combos ac
    LEFT JOIN balances b ON ac.customer_id = b.customer_id AND ac.month = b.month
),
monthly_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        COUNT(*) as total_customers,
        SUM(CASE WHEN month_end_balance > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as positive_count,
        AVG(month_end_balance) as avg_balance
    FROM full_balances
    GROUP BY month
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        positive_count,
        avg_balance,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY positive_count DESC) as highest_rank,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY positive_count ASC) as lowest_rank
    FROM monthly_stats
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT avg_balance FROM ranked WHERE highest_rank = 1) - 
    (SELECT avg_balance FROM ranked WHERE lowest_rank = 1) as difference
FROM ranked
LIMIT 1

-- Compute the difference between avg balance of highest-positive month and lowest-positive month
WITH customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
    FROM customer_transactions
),
months AS (
    SELECT '2020-01' as month
    UNION ALL SELECT '2020-02'
    UNION ALL SELECT '2020-03'
    UNION ALL SELECT '2020-04'
),
balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        substr(txn_date, 1, 7) as month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) - 
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) as month_end_balance
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE substr(txn_date, 1, 4) = '2020'
    GROUP BY customer_id, substr(txn_date, 1, 7)
),
all_combos AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, m.month
    FROM customers c
    CROSS JOIN months m
),
full_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        ac.customer_id,
        ac.month,
        COALESCE(b.month_end_balance, 0) as month_end_balance
    FROM all_combos ac
    LEFT JOIN balances b ON ac.customer_id = b.customer_id AND ac.month = b.month
),
monthly_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        COUNT(*) as total_customers,
        SUM(CASE WHEN month_end_balance > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as positive_count,
        AVG(month_end_balance) as avg_balance
    FROM full_balances
    GROUP BY month
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        positive_count,
        avg_balance,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY positive_count DESC) as highest_rank,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY positive_count ASC) as lowest_rank
    FROM monthly_stats
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT avg_balance FROM ranked WHERE highest_rank = 1) - 
    (SELECT avg_balance FROM ranked WHERE lowest_rank = 1) as difference
FROM ranked
LIMIT 1
